Same KO on a mirin background. Not the unstressed primary contrast.

KO versus WT under CoCl2. Not the unstressed primary contrast.
Two independent 53BP1-null clones pooled (n=6) versus WT (n=3). Clones share a parental line, so the Welch n is not six independent knockouts.
Irradiated arm. Not the baseline primary contrast.
MCF10A is not a cancer line. Scored because it is the clearest public XRCC4-KO RNA-seq and is the biological context for cGAS activation after NHEJ loss.
XRCC4/TP53 double KO versus TP53 KO, so the contrast is XRCC4 loss on a p53-null background.
CRISPR sg53BP1 in hTERT-RPE1. Not a cancer line. Deposited values are integer counts.
53BP1 was knocked out in the ID8 cancer line, but RNA-seq is bulk tumor. Interferon genes can come from infiltrating immune cells.
Bulk KPC allograft tumors. Same immune-infiltrate caveat as ID8. Control and KO count files were joined on gene symbol.
